summary: Nouvelle vérification de sources HMDB expérimentales pour les deux noyaux RMN 1D. Les pages source annoncent des listes de pics CSV, mais les fichiers n’ont pas été téléchargés/importés; aucune courbe ni aucun pic nouveau n’est simulé.

sources.type: 1H NMR predicted (separate, not substituted for experiment)

limitations: HMDB pages confirm availability and conditions, but this environment did not provide the raw CSV/JDX contents for local integration.
Predicted data are kept explicitly separate from experimental records.
No new numeric peaks or complete curves have been fabricated.
licensing_note: HMDB states that commercial redistribution requires explicit permission and acknowledgment; review terms before redistributing downloaded bulk data.
